title: Measures to Encourage Supermarkets and Companies to Adopt More Sustainable Forms of Packaging without Passing on Costs to Consumers
what_it_is: Measures to Encourage Supermarkets and Companies to Adopt More Sustainable Forms of Packaging without Passing on Costs to Consumers

sections.label: Supermarket packaging waste measures
sections.summary: Asked what measures the Ministry will introduce to encourage supermarkets to reduce packaging waste, use sustainable packaging and reduce pre-packaging, without passing costs to consumers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Shahira Abdullah
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment what measures will the Ministry introduce to encourage supermarkets to (i) reduce packaging waste (ii) use more sustainable forms of packaging and (iii) reduce the need for groceries to be pre-packaged, without passing on the cost of sustainability to consumers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The transition to a sustainable and greener economy is necessary for Singapore to thrive in a carbon and resource-constrained future.

sections.label: Mandatory Packaging Reporting framework
sections.summary: Large producers and retailers, including supermarkets, must report annually packaging amounts and reduction plans, laying foundation for an Extended Producer Responsibility scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Packaging waste is one of our main waste streams and a priority area for waste reduction for my Ministry.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We have required large producers of packaged products and retailers, including supermarkets, to report annually the amount of packaging they introduce into Singapore, as well as their plans to reduce, reuse or recycle packaging.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: This Mandatory Packaging Reporting framework focuses companies’ attention on the packaging that they are placing on the market and encourages them to reduce packaging use.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It also lays the foundation for an Extended Producer Responsibility scheme for packaging waste eventually.

sections.label: Packaging Partnership Programme launch
sections.summary: The Singapore Manufacturing Federation and NEA launched the Packaging Partnership Programme in 2021 to support companies in sustainable packaging waste management through workshops and resources.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Singapore Manufacturing Federation and NEA launched the Packaging Partnership Programme in 2021 to support companies in adopting sustainable packaging waste management practices through workshops and resources.

sections.label: Events conducted so far
sections.summary: 12 events have been conducted, including workshop sessions, two webinars and five training sessions for companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: At the moment, we have conducted 12 events, including sessions of workshops, two webinars, five training sessions for the companies.
